title: Delivery Lead
description:
1. About Skillmind Software Visit our website at www.skillmindsoftware.com to learn about Skillmind Software Ltd, our products and our services before you apply. 
 2. Role Purpose The Delivery Lead turns signed contracts into signed acceptance certificates. They run several ERP, SaaS and custom-development projects in parallel, allocate people so no project is neglected, and step in personally when a technical issue threatens a milestone. The role sits between the client and the technical team. It owns scope, schedule, quality and client satisfaction, and keeps the business informed through accurate reports, documentation and time records. 
 3. Key Responsibilities 3.1 Project Delivery & Client Sign-off 
 Own end-to-end delivery of each assigned project: kickoff, requirements, configuration or development, data migration, testing, training, go-live and hypercare. Agree acceptance criteria with the client at kickoff so sign-off conditions are clear from day one. Plan and run User Acceptance Testing (UAT), track defects to closure and obtain formal UAT and go-live sign-off. Secure milestone and final acceptance certificates, and hand them to Finance to trigger invoicing. Control scope through a documented change-request process; no unapproved work goes into delivery. Identify delivery risks early and keep a mitigation plan for each. Manage the hand-over from implementation to the support team, aligned with the client's SLA. 
 3.2 Resource Management Allocate consultants, developers and QA engineers across concurrent projects based on skills, priority and deadlines. Hold a weekly resource review so every active project gets proper attention and no client is left waiting. Rebalance workload when priorities shift, and escalate capacity gaps to the COO with a recommended fix. Assign daily tasks, follow up on progress and remove blockers for the team. Coach team members and give input to their performance reviews. 
 3.3 Technical Issue Resolution Act as first point of escalation for technical problems on any project. Diagnose and resolve issues across ERP configuration, SQL Server databases, integrations, data imports, reports and hosting. Review solution designs and custom code before client delivery to catch problems early. Bring in senior technical resources when an issue is beyond team capacity, and own it until closed. Record root cause and fix for recurring issues in the knowledge base. 
 3.4 Communication & Client Management Act as the single point of contact for clients during delivery. Run weekly status meetings and steering-committee updates with client stakeholders. Handle client escalations calmly and set realistic expectations on timelines and scope. Work with Sales on pre-sales scoping and effort estimates so commitments are deliverable. 
 3.5 Reporting, Documentation & Time Tracking Publish weekly project status reports: progress, milestones, risks, issues and next steps. Maintain project documentation: project charter, plan, business requirements, functional specs, test scripts, training manuals, UAT and go-live sign-off documents. Ensure every team member logs daily work and hours in TeamKazi, the company's project management system. Review timesheets weekly against budgeted hours and flag overruns before they affect margin. Provide monthly delivery reports to management on utilisation, project health and billable hours. 
 4. Qualifications & Experience 4.1 Required 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Information Systems or a related field. 4 to 6 years of experience in IT, including at least 2 years leading ERP or business-software implementations as Delivery Lead, Project Manager or Implementation Lead. Proven record of taking multiple concurrent projects through UAT to formal client sign-off. Hands-on implementation experience with at least one of SAP Business One, Sage 200 Evolution or Odoo. Working knowledge of SQL Server: writing queries, troubleshooting data and supporting reports. Experience coordinating small teams of consultants and developers. 
 4.2 Preferred Project management certification: PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM or Certified ScrumMaster. SAP Business One or Sage Evolution certification. Experience with HR and payroll systems, including Kenyan statutory requirements (willingness to learn Kenyan payroll rules). Exposure to manufacturing, distribution or hospitality clients. Familiarity with .NET applications, ERP SDKs, APIs and system integrations. Experience using AI tools to speed up documentation, testing or reporting. 
 5. Skills & Competencies Delivery Management: Planning, scheduling, scope control and risk management; Agile and Waterfall methods. Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose ERP, database, integration and hosting issues; read logs; write SQL queries. Communication: Clear, confident written and spoken English; able to present to client management. Reporting: Concise weekly status reports and monthly management dashboards. Documentation: BRDs, functional specs, test scripts, user manuals and sign-off documents. Time Management: Disciplined daily time tracking; holds the team to the same standard. Leadership: Assigns work fairly, follows up firmly, resolves conflicts and builds accountability. Client Handling: Manages expectations, negotiates scope and stays calm under escalation. Tools: TeamKazi or similar PM tool (Jira, OpenProject), MS Office/Google Workspace, SQL Server Management Studio. 
 6. Working Conditions & Company Policies Based at the Nairobi office, with regular client-site visits and occasional travel within East Africa; a valid passport is required. May need to support go-lives and critical issues outside normal working hours. All work and hours must be logged daily in TeamKazi. Every new recruit signs the company's zero-tolerance policy on "alcohol at work" and "sexual harassment". 
 This position requires relocation to Nairobi, Kenya. Only interested candidated need apply.

title: Senior Production Manager
description:
Senior Production Manager 
 Location: Bangalore
 Experience: 812 Years
 Industry: Sweets / Food Manufacturing
 Department: Production 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Production Manager with 812 years of relevant experience in the sweets/food manufacturing industry to lead and manage end-to-end production operations. The candidate will be responsible for achieving production targets while ensuring quality, food safety, cost efficiency, productivity, and timely dispatch. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Manage end-to-end production operations for sweets and food products. Plan daily, weekly, and monthly production as per business requirements and sales forecasts. Ensure production targets are achieved within the planned timelines and quality standards. Manage production manpower, shift planning, deployment, and productivity. Monitor production processes to minimize wastage, rework, and production losses. Ensure adherence to quality, hygiene, food safety, and GMP standards . Coordinate with Quality, Purchase, Warehouse, Maintenance, and Sales teams for smooth production operations. Monitor raw material availability and consumption to ensure uninterrupted production. Implement process improvements to improve productivity and reduce production costs. Monitor and control production KPIs such as yield, wastage, efficiency, downtime, and output. Ensure proper maintenance and utilization of production machinery and equipment in coordination with the maintenance team. Maintain production reports, MIS, batch records, and other required documentation. Identify operational issues and take corrective and preventive actions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives across production processes. Ensure compliance with company policies, statutory requirements, and food safety standards. Lead and develop the production team through training, performance monitoring, and effective supervision. 
 Candidate Profile 
 812 years of experience in Production/Manufacturing. Must have relevant experience in the Sweets / Mithai / Food Manufacturing industry. Experience in large-scale sweet production will be highly preferred. Strong knowledge of production planning, manpower management, wastage control, and process improvement. Good understanding of GMP, food safety, hygiene, and quality standards . Strong leadership and team-management skills. Good analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Location: Bangalore or candidates willing to relocate to Bangalore. 
 Key Performance Areas (KPIs) 
 Production output and achievement of production targets Production efficiency and productivity Wastage and yield management Manpower productivity Product quality and rejection control Production cost optimization On-time production and dispatch Food safety and hygiene compliance Process improvement and operational efficiency Interested candidates with strong experience in the sweets/food manufacturing industry are encouraged to apply.

title: Brand Franchise Manager - Derma
description:
Job Summary 
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Brand franchise Manager to ensure successful brand growth and the launch of innovative 1st to launch asset , developing and executing new product launch plans, gathering market insights from Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and measuring the impact of implementation of marketing strategies for brand performance enhancement. Collaborating with the internal stakeholders for brand launch, driving execution and maintaining strong relationships with KOLs.

 Roles & Responsibilities 
• You will be responsible for marketing planning by preparing product launch materials, coordinating launch meetings, training the sales force, and tracking initial product performance for the first 12 months to ensure effective product marketing.
• You will be responsible for brand performance review by gathering market insights, identifying key issues, and implementing action plans to maintain optimal brand performance, including conducting market research for brand positioning correction.
• You will be responsible for interacting with Key Opinion Leader (KOLs), conducting fieldwork to gather insights, updating KOLs on product value, and collating product evidence and clinical reports to build strong relationships and drive growth.
• You will be responsible for Supply Chain Management (SCM) by tracking product quantities and supply, sharing new product plan quantities with the SCM team, and promptly addressing product shortages or excess to ensure product availability in the market.
• You will be responsible for meeting with Regional Sales Managers (RSMs) to collect feedback, gather campaign feedback, and develop region-specific strategies to incorporate regional needs into the product plan and improve performance. Qualification Qualifications Educational qualification-  Science/Pharma/Medical Graduate preferably with MBA in Marketing

 Minimum work experience-  5+ years of experience in Sales & Marketing, Preference for a candidate with experience of working with innovative assets or breakthrough therapies, Dermatology experience may add value though not mandatory

 Skills & attributes
Technical Skills: 
• Understanding of Pharmaceutical industry; ability to interpret market data; gain marketing insights from various resources
• Basic understanding of anatomy and physiology.
• Ability to analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs within the generics market.
• Strong problem-solving skills to address regulatory challenges, market access issues, and product-related obstacles.
  Behavioral Skills: 
• Strong collaborator and excellent communication.
• Good at building and leveraging relationship.
  Additional Information About the Department
Global Generics India 
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.

 Benefits Offered 
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

 Our Work Culture 
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/
